issues.explanation: Chapter 100 says Kongming has returned to Chengdu, but Chapter 101 begins with him retreating to Hanzhong and only afterward traveling to Chengdu. The source chapters support movement toward Chengdu via Hanzhong, not arrival in Chengdu before the Hanzhong stop.
issues.suggested_fix: Change the ending of Chapter 100 to say Kongming retreats toward Chengdu or first returns to Hanzhong; then Chapter 101 can continue with his subsequent journey to Chengdu.
